features.name: interest_match
features.description: Token and category overlap between user travel preferences and attraction category/tags/description.

features.name: category_id_norm
features.description: Deterministic attraction category index divided by 9.

features.name: budget_compatibility
features.description: Compatibility of explicit entrance fee with daily per-person budget (0.7 neutral when price is unavailable).

features.name: distance_from_center_km_norm
features.description: Distance from city center clamped to 50 km and divided by 50.

features.name: distance_from_prev_km_norm
features.description: Distance from previous itinerary stop clamped to 50 km and divided by 50 (falls back to center distance).

features.name: popularity_log_norm
features.description: min(1, log10(1 + popularity) / 4) when sourced popularity exists, otherwise 0.

features.name: has_verified_rating
features.description: 1.0 if a verified rating exists from an external source, otherwise 0.0.

features.name: estimated_duration_norm
features.description: Visit duration (sourced or labelled estimate) clamped to 240 min and divided by 240.

features.name: user_category_feedback_score
features.description: Smoothed historical feedback affinity for the user on the same category: (positive - negative) / (total + 3).

features.name: trip_days_norm
features.description: Available trip days clamped to 14 and divided by 14.

features.name: source_richness_norm
features.description: Provenance diversity + description availability + source confidence.
